problems: The Elenchus of PG 141 prints no column numbers; ordoCol is read from the closing Ordo Rerum (OCR garbled), and colStatus compares the body column with the Ordo. elenchusCol is left empty throughout.
Not entered (apparatus the Elenchus omits): Georgius Metochita's Notitia (Ordo '12753', line 96544, page 1275); Hieronymus/Allatius notes inside Veccus; the 'EPIGRAPHE... ' sub-lists.

Several body pages carry no readable number (cols ~277-283, ~397-613, ~1405-1419): columns there are inferred from neighbouring OCR headers and the pg-colfind map, which lags (col ≈N is often a page or more behind).
Sententia synodalis (281 vs Ordo 284) and the Oratio II of Constantinus (1139 vs Ordo 1159) rest on inference from page headers, not on a read number.
